artifacts.summary: Implementation summary: shared plan-heading corroboration wired into the handoff-present path of all three orchestration engines.

completion_data.completion_summary: Extracted plan-heading corroboration into skill_corroborate_phase_counts() in scripts/skill-base.sh, wired it into the handoff-present branch of the base single-task, base multi-task, and hard single-task orchestration engines, migrated the three pre-existing recovery-path corroboration blocks to call the same shared function, added an 8-fixture test suite, documented the base-mode implement agent's non-writer contract for .orchestrator-handoff.json, and verified the full change (including bash -n, three test suites, and verify-deploy.sh) in a freshly-deployed scratch git worktree without touching the live .claude/ tree.

memory_candidates.content: For SKILL.md orchestration files whose bash fences span hundreds of lines, verify bash -n on the WHOLE fence plus, separately, on just the newly-added lines in isolation. Large pre-existing fences in this repo's skill-orchestrate*/SKILL.md files contain non-bash 'EXIT (partial)'/'EXIT (success...)' pseudocode-diagram lines that make bash -n fail on the whole fence regardless of any edit -- confirm pre-existing failures are byte-identical (same message, only shifted line numbers) against the pre-change HEAD before treating them as unrelated noise.

A git worktree of this repo is clean for scratch-deploy verification because .claude/ is gitignored and not checked out -- but .claude-extensions.json IS git-tracked and carries 'already loaded' extension state into the worktree, which suppresses the headless deploy's per-extension script re-copy for that extension. Separately (and more surprisingly), even a genuinely fresh deploy-headless.sh run against a worktree with .claude-extensions.json removed still does not populate scripts/lib/*.sh or scripts/tests/*.sh subdirectories, nor ~90 other manifest-declared provides.scripts entries (mostly literature-* scripts). Reproduced identically against an unmodified pre-task commit in an isolated control worktree. This is a real, pre-existing, out-of-scope deploy-mechanism gap broader than the previously-documented 'already-loaded extensions' one; work around it for scratch verification by manually copying the missing files from the source store into the scratch tree's .claude/scripts/ before running test suites.

A new scripts/tests/*.sh (or scripts/lib/*.sh) file added to agent-system/extensions/core/ MUST also be registered in manifest.json's provides.scripts array, or it silently never reaches a deployed .claude/ tree even on a fresh install -- check-extension-docs.sh's 'script file on disk NOT in provides.scripts' check catches this, but only if actually run (e.g. as part of a Phase-8-style scratch-deploy audit) before the task is considered done.
